template_info.name: HSA + Ferrocene (Sudlow site I)
template_info.description: Docks ferrocene into human serum albumin (PDB 1AO6, chain A) at Sudlow site I, the principal drug-binding pocket. Receptor preparation, molecular graph, GFN1-xTB CM5 charges, AutoDock4 with iron parameters, and contact analysis. All inputs ship with the package.
template_info.author: BoundaryComputing

metadata.name: HSA + Ferrocene (Sudlow site I)
metadata.description: Docks ferrocene into human serum albumin (PDB 1AO6, chain A) at Sudlow site I, the principal drug-binding pocket. Receptor preparation, molecular graph, GFN1-xTB CM5 charges, AutoDock4 with iron parameters, and contact analysis. All inputs ship with the package.

options.name: Protein Prep
options.description: Clean a protein PDB, protonate with pdb2pqr, and convert to PDBQT (prepare_receptor4) — MetalDock pipeline step 1

case_name.label: Case Name
case_name.docstring: Name for this docking case (forwarded downstream).

output_dir.label: Output Directory
output_dir.docstring: Working dir for protonated/cleaned PDB + receptor PDBQT.

ph.label: Protonation pH
ph.docstring: pH used by pdb2pqr for protonation.

mgltools_dir.label: MGLTools Dir (optional)
mgltools_dir.docstring: AutoDockTools/Utilities24 dir. Leave empty to auto-detect from the active environment.

force_to_run.label: Force to Run
force_to_run.docstring: Execute regardless of previous results. When enabled, the node will always run even if the configuration hasn't changed.

options.name: Ligand Prep
options.description: Canonicalize a metal-complex XYZ (OpenBabel) and build its molecular graph — MetalDock pipeline step 2
options.doc: Canonicalize ligand XYZ (OpenBabel) → build molecular graph (JSON).

case_name.label: Case Name
case_name.docstring: Case name. Leave default to inherit from a predecessor.

output_dir.label: Output Directory
output_dir.docstring: Working dir for canonical XYZ + molecular-graph JSON.

metal_symbol.label: Metal Symbol
metal_symbol.docstring: Metal element symbol (e.g. Re, Ru, Cu). Forwarded downstream.

obabel_path.label: obabel Executable
obabel_path.docstring: OpenBabel CLI binary (used unless the API fallback is forced).

use_openbabel_python_api.label: Force OpenBabel Python API
use_openbabel_python_api.docstring: Skip the obabel CLI and use the Python API directly. Useful when mgltools shadows the conda-forge obabel binary.

force_to_run.label: Force to Run
force_to_run.docstring: Execute regardless of previous results. When enabled, the node will always run even if the configuration hasn't changed.

options.name: QM Charges
options.description: DFT (ORCA/Gaussian/ADF) → CM5 partial charges + Mayer bond orders → enrich molecular graph — MetalDock pipeline step 3
options.doc: DFT (ORCA/Gaussian/ADF) → CM5 charges + bond orders → enrich graph.

output_dir.label: Output Directory
output_dir.docstring: Working dir for QM scratch + enriched graph.

graph_json.label: Molecular Graph (.json)
graph_json.docstring: Graph from mdock_ligand_prep. Leave empty to auto-discover `graph_json` from a predecessor.

xyz_file.label: Canonical XYZ
xyz_file.docstring: Canonicalized geometry. Leave empty to auto-discover `canonical_xyz` from a predecessor.

engine.label: QM Engine
engine.docstring: DFT backend. ORCA is recommended for transition metals.

geom_opt.label: Geometry Optimization
geom_opt.docstring: Optimize geometry before charges (expensive). Off = single-point.

orca_path.label: ORCA Directory (optional)
orca_path.docstring: ORCA install dir. Leave empty if orca is on PATH or ASE_ORCA_COMMAND is set.

force_to_run.label: Force to Run
force_to_run.docstring: Execute regardless of previous results. When enabled, the node will always run even if the configuration hasn't changed.

xtb_path.label: xtb Directory (optional)
xtb_path.docstring: xtb install dir. Leave empty to use the xtb that ships in this node's environment.

xtb_solvent.label: xtb Solvent (optional)
xtb_solvent.docstring: ALPB implicit solvent, e.g. 'water'. Empty = gas phase.

xtb_accuracy.label: xtb Accuracy
xtb_accuracy.docstring: xtb SCC accuracy; lower is tighter (default 1.0).

options.name: Ligand PDBQT
options.description: Convert a charge-enriched molecular graph into an AutoDock PDBQT with ROOT/BRANCH torsion tree (metal-aware freezing) — MetalDock pipeline step 4
options.doc: Enriched graph → ROOT/BRANCH PDBQT with metal-aware torsion freezing.

output_dir.label: Output Directory
output_dir.docstring: Working dir for the ligand PDBQT.

graph_json.label: Enriched Graph (.json)
graph_json.docstring: Charge-enriched graph from mdock_qm_charges. Leave empty to auto-discover `graph_json` from a predecessor.

metal_symbol.label: Metal Symbol
metal_symbol.docstring: Metal element symbol. Leave empty to inherit from a predecessor.

vacant_site.label: Add Vacant-Site Dummy
vacant_site.docstring: Add a dummy atom (DD) at the vacant coordination site.

max_torsions.label: Max Active Torsions
max_torsions.docstring: AutoDock4 hard limit is 32. Excess bonds nearest the metal are frozen first.

freeze_coordination_sphere.label: Freeze Coordination Sphere
freeze_coordination_sphere.docstring: Freeze bonds within 2 bonds of the metal (rigid cage for chelators like DOTA when the metal is bound).

force_to_run.label: Force to Run
force_to_run.docstring: Execute regardless of previous results. When enabled, the node will always run even if the configuration hasn't changed.

options.name: AutoDock Run
options.description: Generate GPF/DPF, run autogrid4 + autodock4, and extract docked poses — MetalDock pipeline step 5

output_dir.label: Output Directory
output_dir.docstring: Working dir for grid/docking files + poses.

ligand_pdbqt.label: Ligand PDBQT
ligand_pdbqt.docstring: Leave empty to auto-discover `ligand_pdbqt` from a predecessor.

receptor_pdbqt.label: Receptor PDBQT
receptor_pdbqt.docstring: Leave empty to auto-discover `receptor_pdbqt` from a predecessor.

graph_json.label: Molecular Graph (.json)
graph_json.docstring: Used for the box center (metal position). Leave empty to auto-discover `graph_json`.

metal_symbol.label: Metal Symbol
metal_symbol.docstring: Leave empty to inherit from a predecessor.

parameter_file.label: AutoDock4 Parameter File
parameter_file.docstring: metal_dock.dat. Leave empty to use the bundled default.

box_center.label: Box Center (x,y,z)
box_center.docstring: Grid box center in Å. Leave empty to center on the metal atom.

force_to_run.label: Force to Run
force_to_run.docstring: Execute regardless of previous results. When enabled, the node will always run even if the configuration hasn't changed.

options.name: Results Analysis
options.description: Binding energies, ligand efficiency, interacting residues, and RMSD from docking output — MetalDock pipeline step 6
options.doc: Binding energies, ligand efficiency, interacting residues, RMSD.

output_dir.label: Output Directory
output_dir.docstring: Working dir for the analysis summary JSON.

dlg_path.label: Docking Log (.dlg)
dlg_path.docstring: Leave empty to auto-discover `dlg_path` from a predecessor.

protein_pdb.label: Protein PDB
protein_pdb.docstring: Cleaned protein for residue contacts. Leave empty to inherit `cleaned_pdb` from a predecessor.

reference_xyz.label: Reference XYZ (optional)
reference_xyz.docstring: Crystal/reference geometry; if set, RMSD is computed per pose.

n_heavy_atoms.label: Heavy Atom Count
n_heavy_atoms.docstring: Heavy atoms in the complex (for ligand efficiency). Leave 0 to inherit `n_heavy_atoms` from a predecessor.

num_poses.label: Poses to Analyze
num_poses.docstring: Max poses to analyze. Leave 0 for all available poses.
